recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit. It completes the published FHIR-20479 clarification across current built Encounter definition/search-parameter surfaces without undoing later approved Encounter definition context or patient-only search parameter semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-20479 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Administration issue asking to clarify Encounter so that a practitioners' meeting may be about a patient even when the patient is not present. The approved resolution changed the resource intro sentence to allow healthcare providers and/or patients, changed Encounter.subject from present to related, and added detail that the patient may not be present.
initial_application: Commit 7c617a3490739b95606a58a83c35e1d44ce3b436 applied the main StructureDefinition changes by updating the resource description and Encounter.subject short/definition. It did not update the root Encounter element definition, which still repeated the old patient-provider sentence, or the Encounter patient/subject search parameter descriptions, which still described the patient or subject as present.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists encounter=Encounter, so the edited Encounter StructureDefinition and search parameter bundle are current build inputs. FHIR-32346 later added the Encounter-vs-Appointment sentence to the root definition; this fix preserves that later context while aligning the opening sentence with FHIR-20479. FHIR-21770 and FHIR-13601 establish that Encounter-patient remains patient-only, so the patient search parameter was updated only from present to related, not broadened to Group.
reconciliation: Changed source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml so the root Encounter definition uses the approved healthcare provider(s), and/or patient(s) wording while keeping the Appointment contrast. Changed source/encounter/bundle-Encounter-search-params.xml so Encounter-patient and Encounter-subject descriptions say related to this encounter rather than present at the encounter.
source_changes: source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml: updated the root Encounter definition's opening sentence to match the FHIR-20479 resource description while preserving the FHIR-32346 Appointment contrast.
source/encounter/bundle-Encounter-search-params.xml: updated Encounter-patient and Encounter-subject search parameter descriptions from present-at-encounter wording to related-to-encounter wording.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive issue that added the Appointment/planned-activities context to the root Encounter definition; this fix preserves that context while aligning the opening sentence with FHIR-20479.
Audited the Encounter-patient search parameter description as patient-only; this fix keeps the patient-only scope while replacing stale presence wording.
Earlier Published/Persuasive issue that removed 'or Group' from Encounter-patient; this fix does not reintroduce Group into that search parameter.
Earlier typo fix for the old 'patient or group present at the encounter' wording; FHIR-20479 later supersedes the presence wording rather than the typo correction.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive PA issue requiring Encounter wording to allow an encounter about a patient who is not present and to change Encounter.subject from present to related.
evidence_items.learned: This is final WG intent and establishes the target source semantics for the reconciliation.
The edited Encounter StructureDefinition and search-parameter bundle are current FHIR core build inputs.

evidence_items.summary: Before reconciliation, the resource description and Encounter.subject used the approved related/not-present wording, but the root Encounter definition still began with the old patient-provider wording.
evidence_items.learned: The authoritative StructureDefinition was internally inconsistent and needed the root definition aligned with FHIR-20479.

evidence_items.summary: Before reconciliation, Encounter-patient and Encounter-subject search parameter descriptions still described the patient or subject as present at the encounter.
evidence_items.learned: The built search parameter documentation retained the obsolete presence requirement and required the same semantic alignment.

evidence_items.summary: #FHIR-20479 changed the Encounter resource description and Encounter.subject short/definition in source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml.
evidence_items.learned: The historical application handled the main requested fields but missed the root definition and search parameter surfaces fixed here.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-32346 added the Encounter-vs-Appointment sentence to the root Encounter definition after the FHIR-20479 decision.
evidence_items.learned: The correct reconciliation is to preserve that later approved second sentence while replacing the stale opening sentence.

evidence_items.summary: The initiating thread discusses practitioner meetings about a patient when the patient is not an attendee; Brian Postlethwaite says Encounter is the correct resource and asks for a tracker clarification.
evidence_items.learned: The community discussion confirms that FHIR-20479 is about removing the implication that the patient must be present.

evidence_items.summary: PA minutes record FHIR-20479 as persuasive with a Brian Postlethwaite/Pascal Pfiffner 7-0-1 vote.
evidence_items.learned: The minutes corroborate the final Jira disposition and do not narrow the requested wording change.
